intro: Martek the Exiled says the Badlands hold a wealth of metal for anyone with the nerve to get it. Indurium is said to stand up to heat and stress, and Martek wants samples to test whether it could serve Fizzle's racecar. Stonevault troggs out in the Badlands are the ones carrying flakes of it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm not out here just to stay away from people. There is a wealth of metal in the Badlands, friend, if you have the guts to get it.
The metal's called indurium and as luck would have it, it is rumored to possess high resistance to heat and stress. It might work for Fizzle's car.
But let's make sure. Get me samples of indurium and I'll test its properties.
True indurium ore lies deep in Uldaman, but the Stonevault troggs of the Badlands sometimes have flakes of it on them. Bring me those flakes.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find any indurium flakes, friend. I have my forge heated up and ready to test them.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah yes, these will do fine. Now let's put them in some heat and see how they fare...
